title: Witness
description: A textual witness to a passage: manuscript, version, fragment, church-father citation, or critical edition. The growth path toward Dead Sea Scrolls, LXX witnesses, papyri, codices, and variants (taxonomy-scaffold v0.2 Patch 4 / Patch 8). Carries siglum, type, date, provenance, and confidence so the apparatus can scale.

siglum.description: Standard critical siglum (e.g. 1QIsaa, P46, B, A, NA28).

language.description: Hebrew | Aramaic | Greek | Latin | Syriac | Coptic | ...

date_range.description: Estimated date; ranges only — never assert a precise date the evidence cannot support.

tradition_text_type.description: e.g. Masoretic, Septuagintal, Byzantine, Alexandrian, Western, Proto-MT.

trust_zone.description: Witnesses are source evidence, not the canonical English layer; default asserted/context.

source_catalog.description: e.g. Leon Levy DSS, INTF, Rahlfs number.
